prerequisites: Prior knowledge in design methodology and computer-aided design.
Prior knowledge regarding: Energy conversion machines and systems
Prior knowledge regarding: Selection and dimensioning of machine elements

learning_outcomes.text: To teach engineering techniques specific to problem-solving and design in the most realistic industrial context possible.

syllabus_topics: Making a judicious choice between alternatives
Elaborating the chosen alternative, concluding with a report
Presenting and defending the alternative/solution to colleagues or superiors
CAD drawing, dimensions and views, assemblies
Disassembly and analysis of products and machines
assessment_rules: The assessment is based on a conceptual presentation, a final presentation, and a design report. The technical-scientific quality of the final result is always decisive for the final score. No alternative exam is organized in the third examination period for students who did not actively or only partially participate during the academic year. For students who did contribute sufficiently, an alternative assessment will be organized for their shortcomings.
